evidence: The harness samples seven fixed boundaries from after_admin_check_stop through after_escape_keyup, writing each boundary to the reviewer report. Samples contain visibility, focus, picker count/expanded state, listbox count, checked-option count, and measured status.
A hidden observation causes reviewer_member_panel_hidden_during_org_proof before foreground restore, Chat setup, and model-backed send.
No hosted/native candidate was run in this review, so the first real visible-to-hidden transition and any product cause remain unverified. This matches the no-hosted/no-UI scope.
missing: A real resource-valid native run is still needed to determine which boundary first observes hidden state. The current samples localize to a boundary interval; they do not observe a visibility event between samples.

findings.finding: A diagnostic persistence error can interrupt the original Escape dismissal/cleanup. after_picker_click is awaited before entering the try/finally, so an error there skips Escape entirely. A failure at before_escape_keydown in finally skips keyDown/keyUp, and a failure at after_escape_keydown skips keyUp. An injected narrow probe reproduced each case; after_escape_keydown failure left actions ending at keyDown with no keyUp.
findings.impact: The instrumentation-only trace can alter the native input sequence it is meant to observe, including leaving Escape pressed and preventing picker cleanup.

findings.finding: One adjacent regression test is red because it locates the end of approvedOrganizationConfig using the removed `// Scope the observer` comment. Moving actingOrganizationPickersExpression into the new diagnostic module removed that anchor. This is a stale source-extraction guard, not evidence of a product behavior regression.
findings.impact: The adjacent organization-boundary suite does not run cleanly after this refactor.

verdict_b.safe_trace_assessment: The evaluator returns only fixed visibility/focus/count/boolean fields. A Happy DOM probe with a checked option UUID verified that the persisted report contains no UUID. Runtime evaluation exceptions are recorded as measured=false and visibility=null without private CDP error text. No raw org ID, token, label, URL, or option value is added by this trace.
verdict_b.gate_assessment: The patch does not change resource admission/capacity logic, timeout constants, authentication/organization proof, trusted click action, checked UUID proof, or source/visibility gates. The unique checked-UUID hash comparison remains in place. The hidden-report gate is before foreground restore and model-backed Chat.
